name: Exec Cluster E11: Futures Rollover Policy
description: Tests: futures_continuation + rollover_policy + risk_unit on ES futures
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC TEST: Futures Rollover Strategy
# Tests: E11 (rollover_policy), E04 (risk_unit with contract_multiplier)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()

# === FUTURES CONTINUATION ===
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l

# === SIGNAL: 20/50 EMA trend (persistent, not pulse) ===
fast_ema = ma(period=20, type=MAType.ema)(close)
slow_ema = ma(period=50, type=MAType.ema)(close)

# Persistent comparison signals — always active when trend holds
is_bullish = fast_ema > slow_ema
is_bearish = fast_ema < slow_ema

held_long = hold_until(is_bullish, is_bearish)
held_short = hold_until(is_bearish, is_bullish)

# === VOLATILITY ===
atr_val = atr(high, low, close, 14)

# === EXECUTION (E16 wiring order) ===
# 1. Rollover policy (E11) — FIRST for futures
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)

# 2. Signal executor (E01)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# 3. Risk-based sizing (E04) with contract_multiplier for ES
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price, contract_multiplier=50)(
    risk_pct=2, stop_distance=atr_val * 2
)

# 4. Trailing stop (E09)
trailing_stop()(distance=atr_val * 3)
